title: Certify the local-ring BIT fallback and common schedule
body:
The retained BIT bad-class fallback needs a full-ring program even when a leading residue vanishes. This package emits that algebraic program and independently checks its complete ADDRESS operator. It also keeps zero shear and identity-pair slots, which are necessary for one instruction schedule across high lifts and diagonal weights.

For every odd prime q, w>=1 and N=2m, the written proof covers invertible matrices of determinant +/-1 with ancestor-only coefficients. It specifies first-unit pivots, diagonal covariance, inverse chronology, determinant sign, field orientations and arbitrary complete spectators. Gaussian elimination, covariance and the allowance are inherited from the source527 theorem; the contribution is the executable schedule and independent consumer. The inherited allowance is 98,682 children at m64, within the selected 131,072 charge; adapters, coefficient preparation and routing remain paid separately. **No new supplier or kappa claim.**

Local validation passed:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-bad-class-fallback
make selected-record-check
git diff --cached --check
```

The registered replay covers 31,584 determinant-sign matrices over Z/3, Z/9, Z/5 and Z/25; 31,296 high lifts in 288 low classes; all coefficients of three weighted 128-coordinate rank42 model residuals; and 64 varying-weight/orientation/spectator fixtures. Twelve behavioral test groups pass normally and with -O, including actual guard removal, nonunit terms, source/receipt corruption, descriptor and spectator defects, and read-only relocation. The independent oracle imports no compiler code and constructs the bad chart by a separate basis-conjugation calculation.

Base and refreshed main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision4. Submitted head: `9022b980917b7a9dd0bf1e9cb8012a16ea30293b`. Only `research/selected-bit-bad-class-fallback/` is added; `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `RESULT.json` and `VERIFY.json` contain the exact scope, pins, receipt and replay. Final overlap covered 409 open PRs and 832 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. [Coordination claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2114#discussioncomment-18934129).

Actual selected residual/owner/common-label binding, physical tape admission, completed-child internal borrowing, full invocation domains, precision and outer transfer remain open. The rank42 witness is in the assumed GL64 cover model, not an emitted selected physical residual. No full selected cold replay, formal-kernel proof, independent human review or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Credit the retained source527 framework and lineage, DreamingOfClouds' PR589 on eumemic's PR555, Adam Gall's PR2084/2097, and Nick Petalas's PR2120/2140. Jose Manuel's PR2157 fixed-route reduction and the active good-child claim are complementary. Earlier PR461/465/490 already give sharper numerical fallback pricing; this is not that improvement. Detailed original credits and exact predecessor heads are retained in the package. Prepared for Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate recursive-interface and exact-verification specialists. Apache-2.0; frozen inputs and selected frontier unchanged.
